module_summary: Destination side of a gray-code CDC FIFO: a pointer child synchronizes the write pointer and generates the read index/valid, and a data child muxes the async storage word into a spill-registered valid/ready output.

anchors.name: dst_data_o
anchors.why: Destination output word from the data child spill register.

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Destination output valid from the data child.

anchors.name: dst_ready_i
anchors.why: Downstream ready consumed by the spill register.

anchors.name: async_data_i
anchors.why: Async FIFO storage array read by the data child via read index.

anchors.name: async_wptr_i
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer from source, synchronized for empty check.

anchors.name: async_rptr_o
anchors.why: Gray-coded read pointer returned to source for full check.

anchors.name: dst_ridx
anchors.why: Binary read index selecting the storage entry in the data child.

anchors.name: dst_valid
anchors.why: Not-empty valid from pointer child into data child.

anchors.name: dst_ready
anchors.why: Spill register ready advancing the read pointer.

groups.name: Read pointer logic
groups.description: Gray read pointer, write pointer sync, empty detection.

groups.name: Read data path
groups.description: Storage mux by read index feeding output spill register.
